latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: edit and export videos with AI in minutes.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for automatic AI-assisted editing.
- Describe your editing instructions (e.g., cut pauses, add transitions), and get a ready-to-download polished video in 1–2 minutes.
- No software to learn; ideal for creators and marketers wanting quick, professional results.
- Session management, credit tracking, and cloud export pipeline built in.
- Handles multiple common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Clear error handling and tips for best results included.
